name: agentc2
description: Desktop SSH manager for Codex, Claude, and Antigravity CLI sessions

scripts.test:chat: npm run build && node tests/chat-protocol.cjs && node tests/chat-service.cjs && node tests/chat-timeline.cjs
scripts.test:oporders: npm run build && python3 tests/oporders.py && node tests/oporders.e2e.cjs && node tests/oporders.ui.e2e.cjs
scripts.test:sitrep: npm run build && python3 tests/sitrep.py && node tests/sitrep.e2e.cjs
scripts.test:exercises: npm run build && node tests/exercises.cjs && python3 tests/exercises.py && node tests/exercises.e2e.cjs
scripts.test:flash: npm run build && python3 tests/flash.py && node tests/flash.e2e.cjs
scripts.test:loop-breaker: npm run build && node tests/loop-breaker.cjs && python3 tests/loop-breaker.py && node tests/loop-breaker.e2e.cjs
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.test:ci: npm run build && node tests/chat-protocol.cjs && node tests/chat-service.cjs && node tests/chat-timeline.cjs && node tests/updates.cjs && node tests/rename.cjs && npm run test:productivity && node tests/loop-breaker.cjs && node tests/readiness.cjs && node tests/exercises.cjs && node tests/cleanup.cjs && node tests/situation.cjs && node tests/reconnect.cjs && node tests/remote-control.cjs && node tests/image-upload.cjs && node tests/tunnels.cjs && node tests/local.cjs && node tests/companion-client.cjs && npm run test:platform && node tests/packaging.cjs && node tests/native-pty.cjs
scripts.test:chat:local: npm run build && cross-env AGENTC2_CHAT_TEST_LOCAL=1 node tests/chat-launch.e2e.cjs
